notes.title: DUNJUNGUY v0.1.8 - Feedback Update
notes.content:
Welcome travelers!  We've gotten a lot of feedback at shows and conventions that we've been to this last year. We've met countless awesome people and have had a ton of fun showing you all DUNJUNGUY!

We went to 6 conventions in 2024, and traveled all over the country, from Texas to Wisconsin. It was an awesome experience. So, to wrap up this year, we wanted to apply a lot of the feedback we got from all of you awesome people to the game. So here's to 2025 and what is to come!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved tavern basement to teach base game mechanics a little better (more to come on this)
[*] Holes are no longer an instant kill, now they damage you and place you outside the hole. Watch out because you can fall back in again...
[*] Fix an infinite money bug in the tavern
[*] Tavern effigy respawn works between floors (still some wonkiness though)
[*] Players should no longer "skip" floors in the DUNJUN
[*] Droppable Items should always appear/render above the floor now
[*] Improve bullywug sorting so head stops clipping into ceiling tiles
[*] Skeletons no longer run in place when finding a path
[*] Quickstart goes right into the DUNJUN instead of back to the tavern
[*] Abilities/Attacks should auto-cast when holding R2 on controller and mouse clicking on keyboard
[*] Slight Improvements to UI and interactivity
[/list]

Thanks for sticking around!
[i]Aga Pito Studios[/i]

notes.title: DUNJUNGUY - 0.1.7 Effigy Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43667470/0458c4d299802135f6d990656a1c733161fef068.png[/img]


[h2][b]Hello Madison Wisconsin![/b][/h2]

We're here at MDEV attending the game showcase hoping to highlight our latest changes to DUNJUNGUY! We are also pitching our game as part of the convention as well. Come check us out if you have the chance.

[b]DUNJUN NEWS[/b]
The tavern and DUNJUN now has a new item called the effigy. If you find one and activate it in the main inventory it will revive your fallen comrade. Even if they fell down one of those pesky holes. The Tavernkeeper now has an something to say instead of just standing there all creepy like. On top of that the axe and combat in general should feel a lot smoother.

[b]Changelog: [/b]
[list]
[*] New Effigy Item - Revive your friends!
[*] New Shopkeeper Interactions
[*] Improved feedbacks when level up happens
[*] Faster axe swings
[*] Fixed issues with Axe skill tree progression
[*] Standardize mana/stamina consumption
[*] Improved particle effects on enemies and coins
[*] Fixed ability names and descriptions
[/list]

notes.title: DUNJUNGUY-0.1.5 - Controller & Performance Fixes
notes.content:
Oh hello there,

We've been busy debugging and finding performance improvements for the DUNJUN since our last update. We've also got some controller bug fixes as well. Apparently they weren't working in some of our menus. Sorry about that...

Special thanks to Matt R, for calling out that controller bug for us!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Spawn all enemies on DUNJUN start to prevent framerate spikes when entering rooms.
- Improved performance around opening doors and inventory lookups for keys.
- Reduced particles and effects on certain projectiles to improve performance
- Fixed controller movement not working properly in some menus
- Fixed the deathknight trail (He now has bloody pools spawning at his feet... watch out!)
- Fix music setting not working properly in Tavern scene
- A few other minor performance related changes to skeletons and other enemies

notes.title: DUNJUNGUY v0.1.3 - Performance Fixes
notes.content:
Hello adventurers,

Wanted to get a minor fix out today to address some performance issues with the previous build.

We realized the skeletons were underpaid. They are now properly unionized and are much happier with their work.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- Improved performance when skeletons attack and pathfind
- Fixed bug where player inventory would get stuck open or closed.

notes.title: DUNJUNGUY v0.1.2 - Minimap Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello weary travelers![/h2]

We're excited to announce a new build of DUNJUNGUY which includes a new minimap. Hold down on the left stick on your controller or press M if you're playing on a laptop and a minimap overlay will appear on screen.

This makes it easier to navigate the DUNJUN. There were way too many people getting lost down there...

[b]Features:[/b]
- All new minimap (press M on keyboard or hold down the left stick on controller)

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- Bow ability improvements
- Skeleton animation and attack improvements
- Bullywug tongue improvements

We are aware of performance issues on Windows and we will be working to improve framerates and stuttering issues reported by some users.

Stick around for more updates coming soon!

Thanks for reading,
[i][b]Aga Pito Studios[/b][/i]
